governing_document: Tamil Nadu Combined Development and Building Rules (TNCDBR) & TN Energy Conservation Code
authority: Housing and Urban Development Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
climate_adaptations: Warm & Humid coastal airflow enhancement provisions.
Mandatory Rainwater Harvesting and solar roof incentives.

rules.description: Aggregate operable area of doors and windows opening directly to exterior air must be at least 1/8th (12.5%) of floor area for tropical warm-humid airflow.
rules.remediation: Increase window area or add cross-ventilation transoms.
